# Guarded Actions release publication

This isolated tooling branch contains no application changes relative to production commit 769bf99ee719f5e353822cdbd75b9259c8fd5fe1. The existing canonical workflow runs its explicitly selected tooling revision through audit, prepare and publish, using only the established job-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN with contents:write. No main workflow merge, PAT, relay, credential repair or new deploy hook is needed.

The 2230 plan must remain finalized:false until exact candidate checks, counts, source trees and artifact digests are complete. All twelve mandatory hosted jobs and ten local/hosted canonical gates remain required. This current-season restoration/acquisition release preserves the established exact-source five-case metadata-only preflight acceptance. The separate source-pinned current-season browser artifact must contain all twelve league/viewport controls and screenshots. Existing hosted Trade resource and league-entry evidence still has its own mandatory integrity checks. No production restoration or recommendation search is performed by publication. Application changes are confined to the separately validated history PR, never this tooling branch.

Recovery archive: local-canonical/ contains the unchanged full canonical output and payload manifest; local-preflight/ contains result.json, raw.log and SHA256SUMS; SCOUT_HANDOFF.md states the exact candidate/tree and the bounded production smoke and independent Scout procedure without any credential. Local and hosted canonical manifest populations are independently pinned in the plan. Prior failed/cancelled attempts have a separate manifested prior archive and never supply passing evidence.

prepare verifies the exact open PR and unchanged production baseline, all required runs/artifacts, original checksums and sanitized attachment manifest, uploads only to the existing draft, then downloads all attachments for byte verification. It neither merges nor tags. After successful preparation, the authorized maintainer may merge the application PR through the normal guarded workflow.

publish requires that exact PR merged at current main with a tree equal to the validated candidate, plus successful preparation on the same frozen publisher SHA. It repeats evidence checks, updates the existing draft target, creates or verifies the annotated immutable tag without overwriting, publishes, verifies immutability and attachment readback, and checks bounded public readiness. The publisher never merges or updates main. Render's existing automatic main deployment remains the only deployment path.
